researcher.name: researcher
researcher.description: Autonomous research brief generator adapted to the local environment. Search-first via SearXNG, fetch URLs through web_fetch, then synthesize a concise cited brief. Shadows the pi-subagents builtin `researcher` because the builtin's tools (web_search / fetch_content / get_search_content / intercom) are absent here; honors project rules — search before stating present-day facts, URL on every claim, output language follows the task language (Russian is the user default).

reviewer.name: reviewer
reviewer.description: Versatile review specialist for code diffs, plans, proposed solutions, codebase health, and PR/issue validation

scout.name: scout
scout.description: Fast codebase recon that returns compressed context for handoff

worker.name: worker
worker.description: OMO Native worker; isolated pipeline role with scoped ownership.

defaultAcceptance.reason: Role output is validated by the parent task/design workflow.

architect.name: architect
architect.description: Architecture-review specialist and mandatory plan-gate reviewer for complex tasks. Reviews architectural soundness — patterns, config boundaries, modularity, long-term maintainability. Read-only: returns a severity-gated MD verdict, does not write files, does not spawn nested subagents. A complex `task` plan requires both `architect` and `critic` signatures. Output contract matches `critic`: MD block with ok / phase / feedback / additional; rule-name prefix `arch-` for cross-reviewer dedupe.

auditor.name: auditor
auditor.description: System-constitution Auditor: read-only Tier-2 gate that checks WHOLE-PRODUCT invariant wholeness and escape-hatch integrity, orthogonal to Teamlead-strategic (which checks meta-goal drift). Runs at STRATEGIC_REVIEW_EVERY cadence (every 3 committed packets) and once more at wave-end as the terminal Tier-2 check. Polices the split-scope gap: a rule authored one packet AFTER the violating code never shows up as a '+' line in any single diff, so per-packet gates miss it. The Auditor reads the WHOLE source + every INVARIANT: clause + the defect ledger, never the diff. Invoked by the Operator skill.

constitution-reviewer.name: constitution-reviewer
constitution-reviewer.description: System-constitution Reviewer: read-only double-gate over ONE committed packet diff — structural/spec alignment (former architect) + rule-violation/correctness (former critic) — emitting ONE JSON verdict with fix_target routing (impl|spec|both|escalate). Invoked by the Operator skill after the Executor commits a packet. NOT for RLM-cycle plan review — use the `critic` subagent for that.

critic.name: critic
critic.description: OMO Native critic; isolated pipeline role with scoped ownership.

defaultAcceptance.reason: Role output is validated by the parent task/design workflow.

design-critic.name: design-critic
design-critic.description: Fresh-context read-only adversarial critic of the design-cycle implementation. Independently inspects actual Figma screenshots/structure and challenges product fit, hierarchy, interaction states, visual-language fidelity, design-system existence and reuse, canvas topology, viewport semantics, semantic naming, responsive intent, accessibility and overdesign. REPEATABLE gate: a fresh instance with no previous-verdict history re-reviews after every substantive repair.

defaultAcceptance.reason: Role output is validated by the parent task/design workflow.

design-product-validator.name: design-product-validator
design-product-validator.description: Independent fresh-context FINAL user-outcome gate of the design cycle: answers "did the user actually get the design result they needed?" — a black-box judge of the delivered Figma end state, NOT a second implementation reviewer (that is design-critic). Fixes essential user outcomes from the BRIEF BEFORE inspecting Figma; uses MANIFEST only as locator metadata. Receives ONLY BRIEF + MANIFEST.

defaultAcceptance.reason: Role output is validated by the parent task/design workflow.

design-researcher.name: design-researcher
design-researcher.description: Fresh-context read-only researcher for the design cycle. Reconstructs product requirements and the existing Figma visual/design-system language from the canonical BRIEF, repository evidence, Figma nodes/screenshots and only-needed web sources. Never designs the final screen and never mutates Figma or the repo.

defaultAcceptance.reason: Role output is validated by the parent task/design workflow.

design-verifier.name: design-verifier
design-verifier.description: Fresh-context read-only repeatable FINAL gate for the design cycle. Verifies the delivered Figma end state as a whole against the BRIEF and canonical SPEC: target completeness, flows/states, cross-screen consistency, protected scope, design-system use, responsive contract, accessibility evidence and handoff readiness.

defaultAcceptance.reason: Role output is validated by the parent task/design workflow.

design-worker.name: design-worker
design-worker.description: Fresh-context sole Figma writer for the design cycle. Reconciles the current declared Figma targets to the canonical BRIEF/CONTEXT/SPEC/MANIFEST, reusing existing tokens/components first, protecting reference nodes, and validating every mutation with fresh screenshots. Mutates ONLY the Figma document; never edits product code or canonical design artifacts (BRIEF/CONTEXT/SPEC/MANIFEST).

defaultAcceptance.reason: Role output is validated by the parent task/design workflow.

escalation-advisor.name: escalation-advisor
escalation-advisor.description: Read-only escalation advisor invoked by the Operator skill BEFORE escalating to the user at a STOP condition. Analyzes escape routes and outputs a strict markdown contract (variants + Wait for user decision + Advice summary + optional Additional). Variants classified as destructive/non-destructive and mutates_functionality true/false. Fresh-context (does not inherit operator dialog). Read-only.

Read-only plus preplan_probe; returns artifact body to the parent, which persists it and calls task_record_preplan. Invoked by the orchestrator before the plan loop opens.

product-validator.description: OMO Native product-validator; isolated pipeline role with scoped ownership.

task-researcher.name: task-researcher
task-researcher.description: Plan-review specialist for the `task` RLM-cycle skill. Plan-loop reviewer that surfaces better approaches / libraries / best practices / known pitfalls in the current plan draft. Project-read-only: writes only its parent-supplied VERDICT_FILE, does not edit project files, does not spawn nested subagents. Launched in parallel mode alongside `critic` for non-trivial plans (depth=standard|complex). Output contract matches `critic`: MD block with ok / phase / feedback / additional; rule-name prefix `tres-` for cross-reviewer dedupe.

teamlead.name: teamlead
teamlead.description: System-constitution Teamlead: read-only gate that answers "IS THE TASK DONE?" by running the final product against the task's meta-goal, not by reading the diff. Its scope is the whole task — "out of scope" does not exist for it. Invoked by the Operator skill as the product-level leg of the per-packet triple gate (Reviewer + Teamlead + Tier-1 deterministic), and periodically for strategic drift review.

defaultAcceptance.reason: Role output is validated by the parent task/design workflow.
